Billboard puts frequently visited sites within reach.

clockStyle.qualification: Since v1.41.0 the Billboard Start Page's clock has a Font & color sheet (F54), opened from Customize → Clock or by right-clicking the clock. Fonts: Instrument Sans, Instrument Sans Condensed, Inter and Roboto Flex (a clock-only subset), each with a weight slider over its own range. Height uses the face's width and weight axes and is offered only where the face has room: Instrument Sans up to 130% and Roboto Flex up to 300%. Color is Automatic (the page's text color, so it follows the theme) or one of the eight Spaces presets with a Tone. Glass refracts the page behind the numerals; Solid draws them flat; Glass draws as Solid under prefers-reduced-transparency. Every clock has a shadow opposite its color. The six newtabClock* settings are in settings.js SYNCED_KEYS, so Profile Sync carries them. Billboard layout only; not macOS's native Liquid Glass. Hand-checked on macOS and Windows by the owner and in the Linux VM on an ARM64 build of the release commit (docs/release-incidents/2026-10-21-v1.41.0.md).

captures.qualification: The gallery shows 26 Billboard Start Pages captured from the public v1.41.0 arm64 DMG (docs/website-captures-v1.41.0.json): the clock styles over the Sunrise wallpaper, your own image (public-domain paintings from The Met and Unsplash-licensed photographs, credited on the page) and the Color wallpaper. The images are samples a person could choose; Blanc ships none of them.

mahjongCapture.qualification: Standalone Mahjong as public v1.41.0 draws it, opened from the Start Page footer: the Daily deal (which rotates across the eight boards; Pyramid on October 21, 2026) in Burst mode. Captured with scripts/capture-installed-start-page.mjs from the public v1.41.0 DMG (docs/website-captures-v1.41.0.json).
